title: Swap the opencode reviewer for dsh
summary: The review workflow's third reviewer changes from opencode (OpenRouter) to dsh (DeepSeek). dsh was previously refused at run time because it documented no read-only mode; this change records one — the DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only environment variable read by dsh's base profile — so the roster in osf.toml becomes codex, claude, dsh. The workflow job is renamed review-dsh, its network allow-list swaps openrouter.ai and models.opencode.ai for api.deepseek.com, it passes DEEPSEEK_API_KEY instead of OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and it gains a check that the pinned review image carries dsh 0.2.0-rc.2. The final reduce job now waits on review-dsh.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: pull_request trigger, base branch
nodes.summary: The review workflow. It builds osf, runs one job per reviewer, then reduces and posts. This change renames the opencode job to review-dsh and re-points it.

nodes.label: build job
nodes.subtitle: osf review work-item, no secrets
nodes.summary: Builds osf from the base branch with no secret and resolves the work item from the linked issue. Every reviewer job needs it.

nodes.label: review codex
nodes.subtitle: bypass inside the container
nodes.summary: Runs the codex reviewer in the review container with its own sandbox and approvals bypass switched on, and checks the image carries codex 0.161.0.

nodes.label: review claude
nodes.subtitle: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
nodes.summary: Runs the claude reviewer in the review container with only its own provider key.

nodes.label: review dsh
nodes.subtitle: was review opencode
nodes.summary: The renamed third reviewer job. It passes DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, allows api.deepseek.com, and fails unless dsh --version in the pinned image prints 0.2.0-rc.2.

nodes.label: dsh version check
nodes.subtitle: docker run ... dsh --version
nodes.summary: A step that runs the pinned review image and compares the printed dsh version against DSH_VERSION, exiting 1 on a mismatch. It exists because the read-only permission mode is read by that release.

nodes.label: review (reduce)
nodes.subtitle: mints the verifier token
nodes.summary: Reduces the saved answers and posts the result. Its needs list now names review-dsh in place of review-opencode.

nodes.label: AGENTS registry
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/agents.rs
nodes.summary: The static list of agents, each with its command, credential variable and read-only mode. dsh's entry gains a read-only mode where it previously had none.

nodes.label: dsh read-only mode
nodes.subtitle: DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only
nodes.summary: The environment variable dsh's base profile reads. In read-only, file writes and edits are refused and an escalation finds no approval channel in a headless run. It removes no tools: shell, web and subagent stay, bounded by the job's network allow-list.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: --reviewer <name>
nodes.summary: Starts one reviewer in the container, writes the diff and log to a read-only folder, and saves the answer. It refuses a reviewer that has neither a read-only nor an in-container mode.

nodes.label: osf review reduce
nodes.subtitle: quorum, quote check
nodes.summary: Re-checks each saved answer against the schema and the lens, applies quorum, and produces the result the final job posts.

nodes.label: osf.toml roster
nodes.subtitle: reviewers = codex, claude, dsh
nodes.summary: This repository's own selection from the agent list. opencode leaves the roster and dsh takes its place, with a comment recording the owner's decision on OpenRouter.

nodes.label: review image
nodes.subtitle: pinned by digest
nodes.summary: The single container image every job runs, pinned by digest. It carries codex, claude and dsh, and the dsh job now asserts the dsh version it carries.

nodes.label: read-only checkout
nodes.subtitle: /pr, /base, /work-item
nodes.summary: The pull request tree, the base config root and the work item, mounted read-only. A reviewer reads the change as data and never builds it.

nodes.label: network allow-list
nodes.subtitle: harden-runner, egress block
nodes.summary: The per-job egress allow-list. The dsh job's list drops openrouter.ai and models.opencode.ai and adds api.deepseek.com, keeping the six GitHub hosts.

nodes.label: api.deepseek.com
nodes.subtitle: dsh's default base URL
nodes.summary: The model endpoint dsh calls on its DeepSeek route. It replaces OpenRouter as the third reviewer's provider host.

nodes.label: openrouter.ai
nodes.subtitle: opencode's provider
nodes.summary: The provider host the opencode job allowed. It leaves the workflow with the job, on the owner's statement that OpenRouter is not going to be used at the moment.

nodes.label: api.openai.com
nodes.subtitle: codex's provider
nodes.summary: The codex job's provider host, unchanged by this change.

nodes.label: api.anthropic.com
nodes.subtitle: claude's provider
nodes.summary: The claude job's provider host, unchanged by this change.

edges.label: dsh --version
edges.summary: The new step that makes the read-only mode's release a checked precondition rather than an assumption.

edges.label: --reviewer dsh
edges.summary: The job's command line changes from --reviewer opencode to --reviewer dsh, and its output file from opencode.json to dsh.json.
The one provider host the dsh job permits.

edges.label: agent entry
edges.summary: The run reads the agent's command, credential variable and read-only mode from the registry. For dsh the read-only mode is now present, so the run no longer refuses it.

edges.label: reviewers list
edges.summary: The roster names dsh where it named opencode, so the registry entry that now carries a read-only mode is the one the run selects.

edges.label: needs
edges.summary: The final job's needs list names review-dsh in place of review-opencode.

flows.title: One dsh review run
flows.summary: What happens when the review-dsh job starts: the image is checked for the pinned dsh, osf starts dsh in its read-only permission mode over the read-only checkout, and dsh answers on standard output through the one provider host the job allows.

messages.label: dsh --version
messages.note: Fails the job unless the image prints 0.2.0-rc.2, the release whose base profile reads DSH_PERMISSION_MODE.

messages.label: osf review run --reviewer dsh
messages.note: The job passes DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and nothing else into the container, and writes the answer to /out/dsh.json.

messages.label: DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only
messages.note: The registry entry supplies the environment pair; the run adds it to dsh's command. Without it the run would refuse dsh as having no read-only mode.

messages.label: prompt + diff file path
messages.note: dsh takes no answer-schema flag and no model flag, so the prompt asks for the JSON answer and dsh runs its default model.

messages.label: model call
messages.note: The only provider host the job's allow-list permits; every other host is blocked.

messages.label: final answer on stdout
messages.note: dsh prints only the final answer on standard output, which the run saves as the reviewer's answer.

views.title: The review check, by container
views.summary: The workflow's jobs, the one image they all run, and the provider each reviewer job is allowed to reach. The third reviewer job is the one this change rewrites.

views.title: Inside the dsh reviewer
